title: Multilingual Cross-domain Perspectives on Online Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection and analysis of online hate speech (racism, sexism, extremism). While it discusses hate speech in the context of religious extremism (Jihadism) and includes a discussion section on the ethical challenges of automated detection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component. It is a technical report on classification and stylometry of hateful rhetoric.
